uncertainty_note: Two uncertainty sources are reported SEPARATELY and never pooled into a single n: (1) across-seed uncertainty - paired t over n=5 (or n=3) training seeds, which reflects training stochasticity; (2) finite-evaluation-family uncertainty - bootstrap over the 1047 exposed and 213 independent source families, which reflects the finite evaluation set. The family bootstrap holds the trained checkpoints fixed and therefore does NOT contain seed variance.
